publicTarget.channel: existing GitHub Pages production path after merge

approval.directive: Build the live homepage to match the approved mockup, not merely be inspired by it.

rollback.strategy: Revert the approved-mockup homepage merge; no DNS, payment, database, checkout or backend authority is mutated.

proven: approved mockup fingerprint is locked in repository governance
ten approved chapter identities and copy are encoded in the public artifact
homepage primary visuals are local authored assets, not Poly Haven/Pexels substitutions
notProven: Founder subjective final visual acceptance after live review
pixel-perfect identity to the raster mockup at every viewport
dynamic API runtime on the apex domain
live checkout, customers, revenue, awards, partnerships or press
external legal, security or accessibility certification

truthBoundary: Merge/build success is not final visual acceptance. Browser evidence plus Founder review of the live result are still required.
